APP01 and your private lab client
On APP01 open Windows Defender Firewall with Advanced Security. Inspect existing IIS inbound
If no suitable rule exists: Inbound Rules → New Rule → Port → TCP → Specific local ports: 443 →
Allow the connection → Domain profile → name Practice Helpdesk HTTPS. Open the new rule →
Scope → Remote IP addresses → These IP addresses → Add your recorded lab subnet. Inspect other
enabled 443 rules too; a broad allow rule can defeat this scope.
Allow TCP 443 only from your recorded lab subnet. If your disposable setup needs HTTP
temporarily, scope TCP 80 to that same subnet and remove the temporary allowance when HTTPS is
ready. Do not open database port 3306.
From the client, test 443 after the next HTTPS lesson; before its binding exists, failure is
expected. No router forwarding or public inbound RDP is needed.
Check: You have a private-only web access plan; DNS resolution works.
